newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel to lower ISDN rates up to 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: SingTel to lower ISDN rates up to 23 pct.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) will lower its Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) international data rates by up to 23 percent, SingTel said in a statement on Tuesday.
The change is effective immediately, it said.

"The rate reductions are aimed at making the service even more affordable especially for those companies using SingTel ISDN for videoconferencing and data transfer with their overseas partners," said Lim Shyong, SingTel vice president of business communications.
He said in the statement that SingTel expected this to encourage greater use of the service.
The rate reduction will make Singapore Telecom's ISDN rates cheaper than most countries with which it has ISDN links, SingTel said.
SingTel has ISDN links to 35 countries.
ISDN allows simultaneous voice, data, text and video communications over one digital line.
